overview: Boss Nass stands among the saga's most memorable figures, known throughout the galaxy as a gungan leader. The bombastic Boss of the Gungan Grand Army who reluctantly allied with Queen Amidala to drive the Trade Federation from Naboo after centuries of tension between Gungans and humans. From backwater cantinas to senate chambers and fleet command centers, Boss Nass's story illustrates how individuals outside the Jedi and Sith orders can still move history.
